say:1:1330121001:0.text: Yes, I take time off every year during the festival.
say:1:1330121001:0.source_cn: 是的，每年的祭典日都是我的休假日。
say:1:1330121001:0.male: Yes, I take time off every year during the festival.
say:1:1330121001:0.female: Yes, I take time off every year during the festival.

say:2:1330121002:0.text: Since most of my friends are already buried here, I had no one to chat with at the festival.
say:2:1330121002:0.source_cn: 虽然我的老朋友们现在大多都躺在这里，就算参加祭典也没人说话。
say:2:1330121002:0.male: Since most of my friends are already buried here, I had no one to chat with at the festival.
say:2:1330121002:0.female: Since most of my friends are already buried here, I had no one to chat with at the festival.

say:3:1330121003:0.text: Still, I do miss the world of the living sometimes after being at the cemetery for too long.
say:3:1330121003:0.source_cn: 但在墓园呆久了，我偶尔也会怀念活人的世界。
say:3:1330121003:0.male: Still, I do miss the world of the living sometimes after being at the cemetery for too long.
say:3:1330121003:0.female: Still, I do miss the world of the living sometimes after being at the cemetery for too long.
